content: German courts: LG Muenchen 3 O 17493/20 (Jan 2022) held embedding Google-hosted Google Fonts violates GDPR because the visitor IP address is transmitted to Google servers; ordered 100 EUR damages, cease-and-desist, 250k EUR threat for non-compliance. Multiple independent legal analyses (activemind.legal, dr-dsgvo.de, decoded.legal, lexology) agree: for German sites, either self-host fonts or use the system font stack; zero third-party requests is the safe baseline (also argued before the LG that alternative without IP transfer exists).
